title: Pile
description: learned/pile.json: lessons the board is watching before it saves them, and which corrections it already read. Type Pile in src/board/learn.ts (Candidate, Dest, LearnSource in the same file; NoteScope in src/huddle/huddle-notes.ts). Written by Learner.writePile in src/board/learner.ts (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, atomicWrite), one step at a time through the Learner's queue. The reader needs candidates to be an array, else it starts an empty pile. Unknown fields must be kept.

candidates.description: At most 300 per kind after pruning; watching candidates seen once expire after 60 days.

scanned.description: Correction keys already read (msg:<uuid|at>, reopen, changes, addon:<id>), by "<slug>/<ticketId>".

since.description: Tickets updated before this aren't read. Set on the first start.

seen.description: When the user last opened the Learned view, by board slug.

text.description: The lesson as one short general rule.

general.description: False while it couldn't be put in general words.

standing.description: The user's words made it a standing rule: saved without a repeat.

changeId.description: The learned/changes.json entry that saved it.

Dest.description: Where a saved lesson goes: the board's rules, or a role's notes (role "_all": every role).

key.description: What counts as one source: the first ticket of a follow-up chain, or huddle:<slug>/<id>.
